"""Permission checks migrated from Meridian CRM 4.2 semantics."""


def can(
    user: dict,
    action: str,
    object: str,
    record: dict,
    role_rows: list[dict],
) -> bool:
    """Return whether *user* may perform *action* on *object* and *record*."""

    if action == "DELETE" and record.get("DEL_FLG", "") == "Y":
        return False

    user_role = user.get("ROLE_ID", "")
    user_id = user.get("USR_ID", "")
    user_team = user.get("TEAM_CD", "")
    owner_id = record.get("OWNER_UID", "")
    owner_team = record.get("TEAM_CD", "")

    for row in role_rows:
        if (
            row.get("role_id", "") != user_role
            or row.get("object", "") != object
            or row.get("action", "") != action
        ):
            continue

        if action == "DELETE" and record.get("DEL_FLG", "") not in ("", "N"):
            return False

        scope = "ALL" if user_role == "ADMIN" else row.get("scope", "")

        if scope == "ALL":
            return True
        if scope == "TEAM" and user_team == owner_team:
            return True
        if scope == "OWN" and owner_id == user_id:
            return True

    return False
```
